Paleontologist Trevor Valle joins Joe Rogan to answer claims that dinosaurs never lived. Valle works with fossils and public science shows. A viral video by Eric Dubay sets up the debate.

Valle plays the denial video and replies point by point. He faults one-way videos that face no questions while they record. He explains how bones, rock layers, and finds across the world fit together. The episode is part science lesson and part media lesson, showing why live pushback matters when bold claims spread fast online. Valle stays patient, even when the claims grow wild.
